explainBack: The foundation pledged funding for AI access. Language and local conditions matter: clear advice cannot create an unavailable clinic. The foundation proposes support, while funding and pilots alone do not demonstrate benefit.
unseenTransfer: If a classroom AI project wins funding, I would ask who and where it was tested, what it was compared with and what improved. A grant does not demonstrate better learning.
